items.title: Infested Cities
items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 10, slot F (under Check for Exposure)
items.text:
INFESTED CITIES
Your character gets exposed if you begin your turn in a city marked with an infested symbol. (If the city has a Plague cube and is also infested, you get exposed only once, not twice.)

rules: Starting a turn in a city with an infested symbol gives 1 exposure.
Plague and infested in the same city still cause only 1 exposure that turn.
mechanics.effect: Adds infestation as an exposure trigger and stops it from stacking with a plague cube.

summary: Beginning your turn in an infested city exposes you once. A plague cube in the same city does not cause a second exposure.
